whatIsHeic.metaTitle: What Is HEIC Format? — Definition, vs JPEG & How to Convert
whatIsHeic.metaDescription: HEIC (High Efficiency Image Container) is Apple’s photo format that saves up to 50% space vs JPEG. Learn what HEIC is, how it works, and how to convert HEIC to PNG or JPG for free.
whatIsHeic.cardDesc: Apple’s photo format explained: file size, quality, and how to open HEIC anywhere.
whatIsHeic.intro: HEIC (High Efficiency Image Container) is the default photo format on iPhones and iPads since iOS 11. It stores images using the HEIF standard and HEVC compression, packing roughly twice the quality into about half the file size of a JPEG.
whatIsHeic.s1Body: HEIC shrinks file sizes without visible quality loss, so your iPhone can store more photos. It also supports modern features JPEG can’t: transparency, 16-bit color, and embedded Live Photo or depth data.
whatIsHeic.s2Title: HEIC vs JPEG: The Key Differences
whatIsHeic.s2Body: JPEG is smaller in compatibility but larger in file size; HEIC is the opposite. A HEIC photo is typically 40–50% smaller than an equivalent JPEG, yet holds more detail. The trade-off is that HEIC needs a compatible decoder, which most non-Apple devices lack by default.
whatIsHeic.s3Body: Any photo shot on an iPhone or iPad (unless you changed the camera format), images exported from macOS Photos, or pictures shared via AirDrop and iCloud are usually HEIC. Windows PCs and most Android phones can’t open them without help.
whatIsHeic.s4Title: How to Convert HEIC to a Compatible Format
whatIsHeic.s4Body: The easiest fix is to convert. Use the free converter above to turn HEIC into PNG, JPG, or WebP — entirely in your browser, with no upload and no software to install. Your files never leave your device.
whatIsHeic.conclusion: HEIC is excellent on Apple devices but limited elsewhere. Converting to PNG or JPG is the simplest way to make your photos usable everywhere.

faq.a: HEIC (High Efficiency Image Format) is the photo format Apple adopted starting with iOS 11. It uses HEVC video compression, producing files roughly half the size of JPEG at the same perceived quality.

faq.q: Why does the iPhone shoot HEIC instead of JPEG by default?
faq.a: HEICs newer compression keeps photo quality visually identical while shrinking files to about half of JPEG, saving storage and letting you keep more photos on your device.

faq.q: Can HEIC be converted to JPEG or PNG?
faq.a: Yes. This tool converts entirely in your browser via WASM — your files are never uploaded to any server, and you can download them immediately after conversion.

heicVsJpeg.metaTitle: HEIC vs JPEG — Which Is Better? File Size, Quality & Compatibility
heicVsJpeg.metaDescription: HEIC vs JPEG: which should you use? Compare file size, image quality, and compatibility, and learn when to convert HEIC to JPEG for sharing and printing.
heicVsJpeg.cardDesc: File size, image quality, and compatibility compared — and when to convert.
heicVsJpeg.h1: HEIC vs JPEG: Which Format Is Better?
heicVsJpeg.intro: Both formats store your photos, but they work in very different ways. Here’s the practical comparison to help you choose — and know when to convert.
heicVsJpeg.s1Body: At the same visual quality, a HEIC file is roughly 40–50% smaller than JPEG. If you shoot hundreds of photos, that difference means far more storage left on your phone.
heicVsJpeg.s2Title: Image Quality: HEIC Is More Efficient
heicVsJpeg.s2Body: HEIC uses modern compression that preserves detail and dynamic range better than JPEG’s older algorithm. For archiving or editing, HEIC keeps more information per byte.
heicVsJpeg.s3Body: JPEG opens on every device, browser, and app made in the last 25 years. HEIC needs a decoder that Windows, Android, and many websites don’t have by default.
heicVsJpeg.s4Title: When to Convert HEIC to JPEG
heicVsJpeg.s4Body: Convert to JPEG when sharing with friends, uploading to social media, or sending to print labs. Use the converter above to change HEIC to JPG in seconds — no upload, fully private.
heicVsJpeg.s5Title: Why Converted PNG Files Get So Big
heicVsJpeg.s5Body: HEIC is "high-efficiency lossy compression" while PNG is "lossless but weak compression". An iPhone photo is essentially HEVC-encoded, which compresses smooth gradients and fine noise extremely well; PNG's DEFLATE algorithm barely shrinks real photos (it shines on screenshots and line art, not photographs). Do the math and it adds up: a 12MP iPhone photo (4032×3024) is about 48.8 MB of uncompressed RGBA data. After PNG compression it typically lands at 15–30 MB — exactly the 15.5 MB / 30.1 MB figures you may have measured. So it isn't abnormal bloat; it's simply PNG's normal size. A secondary factor: our conversion pipeline keeps the alpha (transparency) channel even for opaque photos, adding roughly 25% versus plain RGB. But compared with PNG's own expansion, that's minor. For photos, PNG just isn't necessary. Switching to JPG or WebP shrinks the file back to near the original HEIC size with no visible difference: the same 12MP photo is about 24 MB as JPG (quality 90) and about 1.53 MB as WebP (quality 90). That's precisely why most HEIC converters default to JPG.
heicVsJpeg.conclusion: Keep HEIC on your iPhone for storage, but convert to JPEG whenever a file needs to travel. It's the best of both worlds.

faq.q: Which is better, HEIC or JPEG?
faq.a: It depends on the use. HEIC is smaller and higher quality, ideal for storage on your iPhone. JPEG has the widest compatibility — nearly every device, app, and social platform opens it directly — making it best for sharing.

faq.q: Why does converting HEIC to PNG make the file much bigger?
faq.a: HEIC is efficient lossy compression; PNG is lossless but compresses photos poorly. A 12MP iPhone photo is about 48.8MB of raw data, and after PNG compression its typically still 15 to 30MB — a 7 to 12x size increase. For photos, use JPG or WebP instead.

faq.q: What format should I convert photos to for sharing?
faq.a: Choose JPEG for maximum compatibility, or WebP when you want smaller files and the platform supports it. Both are visually near-identical and far better than PNG for photos.

openHeicWindows.metaDescription: Can’t open HEIC files on Windows? Learn how to view HEIC photos on Windows 10/11 with the free HEIF Image Extensions, or convert HEIC to JPG/PNG in your browser — no software needed.
openHeicWindows.cardDesc: How to view HEIC photos on Windows 10/11, or convert them in your browser.
openHeicWindows.h1: How to Open HEIC Files on Windows
openHeicWindows.intro: Windows doesn’t open HEIC photos by default, which is why double-clicking one often shows a blank icon. Here are the three ways to view or convert them.
openHeicWindows.s1Title: Option 1: Install HEIF Image Extensions (Microsoft Store)
openHeicWindows.s1Body: Microsoft offers a free HEIF Image Extensions pack in the Microsoft Store. Install it, and Windows Photos will open HEIC files natively. Note: some variants also need the HEVC Video Extensions — a small one-time fee in some regions.
openHeicWindows.s2Title: Option 2: Convert HEIC to JPG/PNG in Your Browser
openHeicWindows.s2Body: No software, no store, no account. Use the free converter above: drop your HEIC files in, pick JPG or PNG, and download the results. Everything runs locally in your browser, so even sensitive photos stay private.
openHeicWindows.s3Body: Desktop apps like IrfanView or XnView can open HEIC once the proper codecs are present. They’re handy for bulk browsing but require installation.
openHeicWindows.s4Body: Need to view one or two photos occasionally? The HEIF extension is fine. Need to share, print, or process many files? Converting to JPG/PNG with the tool above is faster and works everywhere.
openHeicWindows.conclusion: Whether you install a codec or convert in your browser, opening HEIC on Windows takes minutes — and converting gives you files that work on any device.

faq.q: Can the Windows Photos app open HEIC directly?
faq.a: Most Windows 10/11 PCs cannot by default. You need to install the "HEIF Image Extensions" (and optionally the HEVC Video Extensions) from the Microsoft Store; then the Photos app can preview HEIC files.

faq.q: How can I view HEIC on Windows without installing software?
faq.a: Use this tool: open the page in your browser, drop in your HEIC files, and preview or convert them to JPG/WebP locally — no install required.

faq.q: Is it safe to convert HEIC with this tool?
faq.a: Yes. Conversion runs entirely in your browser via WebAssembly; your files are never uploaded to any server, making it safe for private photos.

openHeicMac.metaTitle: How to Open HEIC on Mac — Preview, Photos & Free Browser Converter
openHeicMac.metaDescription: HEIC files open natively on Mac. Learn how to view HEIC in Preview and Photos, and how to convert HEIC to JPG/PNG/PDF in your browser when you need a shareable file.
openHeicMac.cardDesc: macOS opens HEIC natively — and how to convert it for sharing.
openHeicMac.h1: How to Open HEIC Files on Mac
openHeicMac.intro: Good news for Mac users: unlike Windows, macOS has opened HEIC photos natively for years. Here is how to view them and when to convert.
openHeicMac.s1Body: Select a HEIC file in Finder and press Space for Quick Look, or open it in Preview from the right-click menu. macOS decodes HEIC without any extra software, and you can export to JPG or PNG from Preview’s File → Export menu.
openHeicMac.s2Title: Open HEIC in the Photos App
openHeicMac.s2Body: Photos imports HEIC automatically and shows it in your library. If you want a shareable copy, select the photo, choose File → Export → Export N Photos, and pick JPG or PNG with your preferred size.
openHeicMac.s3Title: Convert HEIC When Sharing Outside Apple
openHeicMac.s3Body: Preview and Photos work great on a Mac, but files you send to Windows users, Android phones, or most websites still need JPG, PNG, or PDF. Use the free converter above to turn HEIC into those formats right in your browser — no upload, fully private.
openHeicMac.conclusion: On a Mac, HEIC needs no special app to view. Convert only when a file has to leave the Apple ecosystem, and the browser converter above handles it in seconds.

faq.q: Can Mac open HEIC files natively?
faq.a: Yes. macOS Preview and Photos open HEIC without any add-on since macOS High Sierra. Press Space in Finder for a Quick Look preview, or open the file in Preview.

faq.q: How do I convert HEIC to JPG on Mac?
faq.a: Open the HEIC in Preview, then File → Export and choose JPEG. Or use the free browser converter above to change HEIC to JPG, PNG, or PDF without installing anything.

faq.q: Why convert HEIC if Mac already opens it?
faq.a: macOS opens HEIC fine, but Windows PCs, Android phones, and many websites cannot. Converting to JPG/PNG/PDF makes the file usable for anyone you share it with.
